title: Sauteed Spinach and Mushrooms
description: Ready in just 30-minutes, this easy recipe for sauteed spinach and mushrooms will pair perfectly with any main course.
ingredients: 0.125 teaspoon ground black pepper, or to taste
2 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese, or to taste

steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or deep frying pan over medium heat. Add onion and saute until soft, 3 to 5 minutes, depending on how soft you like it. Add mushrooms and saute for 4 to 5 minutes. Add garlic and saute for 1 more minute. Add tomato and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Remove mixture to a dish and keep warm.

Add remaining 1 tablespoon oil to the same pan over medium-high heat. Add spinach, salt, and pepper. Cook, tossing continually, until spinach begins to wilt, 1 to 2 minutes. Add onion mixture and mix until thoroughly incorporated. Continue to toss and stir until spinach is cooked to your desired doneness.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese to serve.
